title: Flow card: a rounded paper band with 3-5 hand-drawn crayon-line icons (data stack, laptop, fork, page, person) joined by clay arrows, a sans label under each
use: A process or pipeline in one line (sources to model to scenarios to report); labels are slots, count sets how many nodes, icon_start picks which icon the row begins with.

count.note: number of nodes in the flow

icon_start.note: which icon the row starts with (stack, laptop, fork, page, person; the rest follow in that order)

relations: Band 1360 x 240 units, full radius, paper with a 1 unit hairline, centred about y 420; nodes at equal steps along the band (count 3-5), icons 1.8x their local 84-unit box with 3.2-unit crayon-line strokes in ink.
Arrows are clay, 4.4 units, a shaft and a two-stroke head, kept 18 units clear of both icons; labels are 24 units sans #5E5D59 centred under each node, 64 units below the band, never on the band.
decoration: The paper band, the icons and the clay arrows (strokes through the crayon line filter, which the static check never measures); the label text is the only measured content.

provenance.corpus: research-report kit (examples/institute-essay-report-kit): our own original long-read page; its hand-drawn flow diagram, re-set as a card; all copy is a placeholder
provenance.experiment: styles/institute-essay/style.json provenance (two public reference pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped); the crayon texture is the owner's request to match the references' hand-made look
provenance.method: The kit page's flow figure (figure.flow) lifted into a parametric template: a paper band, line icons drawn as strokes through an SVG turbulence mask, clay arrows, labels as slots.
measured: Kit figure: band 880 x 110 on a 920 viewBox, ink icons 3.2 stroke, clay arrows 2.4 stroke, labels sans 14 under the band (scaled 1.74x here).
Template: 3, 4 and 5 nodes and every icon offset pass the static check; light and dark pass.
